params.prompt:
SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE bracelet only, lying flat on the top face in a relaxed oval, the clasp at the back, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; in it the bracelet lies straight on a pearly plastic sleeve: ignore the sleeve, its creases and glare, the plain margin, and any other jewellery at the edges. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A CLOVER-LINK BRACELET: one single line of about fifteen IDENTICAL small four-petal clovers, linked one after another by a tiny round gold jump ring. Each clover is four ROUND light sky-blue stones in a two-by-two quatrefoil, each stone in its own round gold cup edged with a fine BEADED milgrain rim of tiny gold dots, and ONE tiny clear stone at the very centre where the four petals meet. Along the bracelet every clover sits like a diamond, one petal pointing forward along the line, one back and one to each side, and each gold ring joins the tip of one clover's petal to the tip of the next. One gold lobster clasp at one end; a short gold extender chain with a small round gold tag at the other. Every clover has exactly four round stones plus the tiny clear centre stone: never five petals, never heart-shaped or pointed petals, never solid gold, enamel or mother-of-pearl clovers. The clovers never touch or fuse into a band: a small gap with one gold ring between each pair. Every petal stone is clear light sky blue as in IMAGE 1, never navy, never teal-green, never opaque turquoise, never mixed with other colours. The beaded rims stay fine gold dots.

SCALE TEST: Each clover is about 10mm across, the size of a small fingernail; each round stone is about 3.5mm, the size of a peppercorn; the bracelet is a delicate line only 1cm wide and about 19cm long. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
